Episodes.Title: A night with my male best friend
Inviting someone is all about timing

Entries.Title: Red Swan
Entries.Description: Oh Wan-soo, head of NOW Foundation, becomes the target of a shooting while on the way to a fundraiser. Do-yoon, who is investigating his friend's death, comes to her rescue.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Oh Wan-soo, head of NOW Foundation, becomes the target of a shooting while on the way to a fundraiser. Do-yoon, who is investigating his friend's death, comes to her rescue.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Wan-soo witnesses a shocking scene during the fundraiser. After getting intoxicated, she unexpectedly approaches Do-yoon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Wan-soo refuses to divorce Yongkook, while Tae-ra stands firm beside him. Tensions escalate as the day of the Hwain Group family's photoshoot nears. During the photoshoot, Miran replaces Wan-soo's deceased son with Yongkook's illegitimate child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Do-yoon worries for Wan-soo's safety as she holds a press conference regarding Hwain Group. He warns that the shooter who targeted her in Manila is within Hwain Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Wan-soo departs with Do-yoon after her mother's death. Meanwhile, Do-yoon investigates "Palseongbok," a key location regarding the Hwain Group's slush fund.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: While returning from the welfare center, Do-yoon narrowly saves Wan-soo's life from an explosion. Wan-soo asks for Do-yoon's help to retrieve the original copy of the NOW Foundation's ledger to catch the culprit within Hwain Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Wan-soo's brother gets arrested for embezzlement. Wan-soo visits Busan under Do-yoon's protection, but faces another attack.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Furious over the scandal fabricated by his mother, Yong-kook vents his long-standing anger at his mother. Meanwhile, the former chairman's will is disclosed, shocking everyone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The former chairman's will sparks a clash. Meanwhile, Wan-soo's brother gets into an accident while Mi-ran faces a prosecution summons. The mysteries surrounding the former chairman's death unravel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran goes into custody. Meanwhile, a shooting takes place, and Wan-soo is implicated as a suspect. The mastermind behind it all is revealed.

Entries.Title: Family Matters
Entries.Description: The mysterious Baek family moves to Kumsu city and opens the "Pawfect Haven Animal Hospital." The same day a young woman, Lee Yu-jin, is reported missing in Kumsu mountains. Worries of a serial killer called "Doom-veloper" surface.  The Baek family son, Ji-hoon, and daughter, Ji-woo, are threatened by local bully Jo Kyu-tae.  They decide to take their problem home to Mother, Han Young-su, to remedy.

Episodes.Title: Mom's Recipe
Episodes.Description: The mysterious Baek family moves to Kumsu city and opens the "Pawfect Haven Animal Hospital." The same day a young woman, Lee Yu-jin, is reported missing in Kumsu mountains. Worries of a serial killer called "Doom-veloper" surface.  The Baek family son, Ji-hoon, and daughter, Ji-woo, are threatened by local bully Jo Kyu-tae.  They decide to take their problem home to Mother, Han Young-su, to remedy.

Episodes.Title: Karma
Episodes.Description: Mother gives Kyu-tae a "treatment" and he reveils that Park Jae-gon, the student president, is actually the school's Sex Crime Ring Lord. Jung Ho-chul, the murderer, escapes from the Baek's. The Baek family turns over Lee Yu-jin's body to the police.

Episodes.Title: Cat Claw
Episodes.Description: Detective Kang Jeong-hwan and Officer Oh Man-joong of the Homicide Squad question the Baeks.  Ji-hoon's investigates the sex crimes and uncovers Jang No-won, Director of Urban Development, is the lead instigator. Jo Hae-pal, the National Gang Boss and restrauant owner, kidnaps Ji-hoon and Kwon Min-jung in retaliation for Young-su's treatment of his son.

Episodes.Title: A Good Samaritan
Episodes.Description: Young-su exacts justice for Shin Ju-kyung and her father while Baek Cheol-hee, Father, goes to rescue Ji-hoon and Kwon Min-jeong. Young-su confronts Yoon Myung-hwan, Pastor of Aspirations Church about No-wan's sexual crimes. Detective Kang goes to the animal hospital to confront Cheol-hee only to have Jung Ho-chul arrive to kill Cheol-hee.

Episodes.Title: La Espada
Episodes.Description: The reason for the Baek family move to Kamsu is revealed. Detective Kang finds out who the Baeks are. Chief Oh and Ryu Mi-ok, Number 12, capture Young-su and Ji-won to harvest their organs. New facets concerning Pastor Yoon are revealed.

Episodes.Title: Uphill Battle
Episodes.Description: Doom-veloper comes out of hiding. Young-su strives to save Cheol-hee but the family falls into disarray and is confronted on three fronts.

Entries.Title: What Comes After Love
Entries.Description: Hong and Jungo meet fatefully on the first day they arrive in Tokyo. The spring, summer, and fall of that year were beautiful times for the two of them. Five years later, the two meet again by chance in Korea.

Episodes.Title: Do you believe in unchanging love?
Episodes.Description: Hong and Jungo meet fatefully on the first day they arrive in Tokyo. The spring, summer, and fall of that year were beautiful times for the two of them. Five years later, the two meet again by chance in Korea.

Episodes.Title: If I had said anything back then…
Episodes.Description: On the first day of arriving in Tokyo, Hong and Jungo met like fate. The spring, summer, and fall of that year were beautiful times for both of them. Five years later, in South Korea, the two meet again by chance.

Episodes.Title: It was nothing...
Episodes.Description: Hong keeps reiterating that his reunion with Jungo is nothing. Min-jun, who loves Hong, also senses her confusedness, but tries to ignore her and keep her usual self.

Episodes.Title: Lastly... I hope that's not all...
Episodes.Description: Jungo waited for her on Hong's daily run. Hong is surprised by Jungo's unexpected appearance, but he tries his best to ignore him. In three more days, Jungo will be back in Japan.

Episodes.Title: Is an unrequited love... still love?
Episodes.Description: Min-jun eventually goes to Jungo's autograph hall and warns Jungo not to shake Hong anymore. Jungo's hope that maybe he can start over with her is slipping away again.

Episodes.Title: Things you only learn with time...
Episodes.Description: The night before Jungo returns to Japan, Hong calls him. Hesitated by Jungo's earnest request to meet and talk one last time, Hong ends up heading to his hotel.

Entries.Title: The Midnight Romance in Hagwon
Entries.Description: Famous star instructor Seo Hye-jin works until midnight at the academy like any other day. As she stares at the Hall of Fame in the lobby, Joon-ho's name catches her eye. He is one of her proud boast as she did her best to teach him, and he made it into a prestigious university. At the same time, Joon-ho decides to resign from his company and make a new beginning as a rookie instructor.

Episodes.Title: The Hall of Fame
Episodes.Description: Famous star instructor Seo Hye-jin works until midnight at the academy like any other day. As she stares at the Hall of Fame in the lobby, Joon-ho's name catches her eye. He is one of her proud boast as she did her best to teach him, and he made it into a prestigious university. At the same time, Joon-ho decides to resign from his company and make a new beginning as a rookie instructor.

Episodes.Title: The Test Lecture
Episodes.Description: Even though Hye-jin tries to dissuade Joon-ho, he already passed the first written exam and is getting ready for the test lecture. Therefore, Hye-jin privately asks Ji-seok to disapprove of him. Meanwhile, Sang-sub, the Korean language teacher at Chanyoung High, makes a declaration that creates huge confusion among the students and academies.

Episodes.Title: A Teacher And Student Sally Forth
Episodes.Description: A clandestine endeavour dubbed "Teacher and Student Sally Forth" sparks a covert tutoring session led solely by Hye-jin for Joon-ho. Alone in an office after hours, they exchange determined gazes as they delve into a specialized lesson. Meanwhile, the renowned Director Choi, also known as the White Haired Witch, sets her sights on expanding her academy.

Episodes.Title: One-On-One Lecture
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Joon-ho's optimism for their collaborative lecture fades as they discover only one student has attended their free session. Shocked, Hye-jin collapses emotionally while Joon-ho supports her in regaining composure. They soon learn of a tactic by Choi Sun Academy to dissuade students from considering switching, but the lone attendee might just potentially change the game.

Episodes.Title: The Changes
Episodes.Description: Director Choi Hyung-sun, the White Haired Witch, finds out that Hye-jin and Joon-ho taught the class even though there was only one student. She checks on Si-woo to see if he wants to switch academies and asks about the lecture. After hearing about the lecture, she calls Hye-jin to meet up. Meanwhile, Joon-ho asks Hye-jin not to leave the academy and stay with him for at least a year.

Episodes.Title: The New Class
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho finds out that Hye-jin has been helping him out by taking a loss. He tells her that he'll work on his own, and Hye-jin gets strange feelings from his attitude. Meanwhile, the new class opens, and Director Kim gets in an awkward position because his plan to demote Hye-jin fails. He feels worried about Hye-jin leaving the academy. He calls Hye-jin out to talk about it. And Joon-ho tags along with her.

Episodes.Title: I Just Confessed My Feelings to You
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho confesses his feelings for Hye-jin and he wants to know what she thinks about him. However, an unexpected visit takes his chance away. Joon-ho wants to talk about it the next day, but Hye-jin has to go and see the director who got hungover. Hye-jin decides to leave the academy and move to Choisun. But after running into Si-woo, she remembers something that she had forgotten about.

Episodes.Title: Can You Not Fall For Joon-ho?
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin tells the director that she won’t leave the academy and teach the Heewon High class. Hye-jin goes to So Young’s office and talks about her decision and what she thinks about Joon-ho with her. After having some beer, she finally confronts her true feelings. Joon-ho comes to take her home, and the two finally confirm their feelings toward each other.

Episodes.Title: Why Have You Come to See Me?
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Joon-ho become more intimate, and the two enjoy dating in secret at the academy. The exams are over, and the teachers are busy checking the results of the students. Si-woo comes to the academy and talks about his concerns. Joon-ho becomes more determined to help Si-woo get good grades in Korean. Meanwhile, an unexpected visitor comes to see Hye-jin.

Episodes.Title: A New Instructor
Episodes.Description: Pyo Sang-seob tells Hye-jin that he will be teaching at Choisun Academy. He tells her that the mid-term incident made him think about being a teacher, and it led to quitting his job and starting a new career. Hye-jin is shocked to hear the news though she had an argument with him, she still had respect for him. Meanwhile, Joon-ho doesn’t have a clue why Hye-jin feels complicated about Sang-seob.

Episodes.Title: A New Class
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho’s parents meddle in his work and try to help him become successful in their ways, but Joon-ho feels uncomfortable about it. Seung-hui feels threatened by Hye-jin who is getting all the support from the director. She meets up with Hyung-sun to talk about their future. Meanwhile, Jun-ho wants to open a class that teaches how to read to the students. However, Hye-jin finds it too idealistic.

Episodes.Title: Hye-jin’s Future
Episodes.Description: Sang-seob tells Hye-jin that someone copied her teaching material to use it against her. Joon-ho and Hye-jin’s argument continues, and it gives Sang-seob food for thought. Hye-jin decides to support Joon-ho, but the academy doesn’t approve of opening a new class. Meanwhile, Seung-hui invites Hye-jin to dinner to talk about their future together.

Episodes.Title: Scandal
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin decides to give up her teaching materials and turn down the vice-director’s offer to leave the academy with her. However, Hyung-sun reveals Hye-jin and Joon-ho’s relationship, and Seung-hui decides to use it to her advantage. Meanwhile, one of the instructors who found out about Hye-jin and Joon-ho gathers a meeting to talk about the spreading rumors.

Episodes.Title: Love Me
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Joon-ho decide to face the situation with no lies, but they are worried and feel sorry for the people who will be harmed because of them. The other instructors are complaining about the possible privileges that Joon-ho might have earned from Hye-jin. The rumors spread to the students and parents, and it damaged Hye-jin’s reputation. To save the academy from falling apart, Hyun-tak suggests Joon-ho leave the academy.

Episodes.Title: Joon-ho’s Plan
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho talks about how frustrated he was when he realised that there was nothing he could do to help Hye-jin. Hyun-tak is worried about managing the academy as students are leaving after Hye-jin and Joon-ho’s scandal. Seung-hui meets up with other instructors to have them on her side, and Joon-ho decides to face Seung-hui himself to solve the matter.

Episodes.Title: I’ll Give You Everything You Want
Episodes.Description: Some instructors leave the academy, and some request to meet Hyun-tak to talk about their plans. Seung-hui reaches out to Min-jin and asks her to be her spy in Choi-sun and betray Hye-jin. After discovering what Seung-hui did, Hye-jin decides to face the one behind all the schemes around her. As she goes through the struggles, she thinks about what she really wants to do.

Episodes.Title: Two Men in a Failing Company
Late Night, Just Us at the Office
A Reset in Relationship is Needed
Last Day at Work with My Boyfriend

Entries.Title: Cinderella at 2AM
Entries.Description: After dating Ju-won for a year and a half without knowing he was the youngest son of the AL Group family, Yoon-seo decides to break up with him at his mother's request while accepting her money. As promised, she attempts to break up with him by making him gradually resent her. However, she gets drunk and unknowingly calls him to break up.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, Seo Ju-won
Episodes.Description: After dating Ju-won for a year and a half without knowing he was the youngest son of the AL Group family, Yoon-seo decides to break up with him at his mother's request while accepting her money. As promised, she attempts to break up with him by making him gradually resent her. However, she gets drunk and unknowingly calls him to break up.

Episodes.Title: A Declaration of War
Episodes.Description: Now, as the AL CARD's director and Yoon-seo's superior, Ju-won declares war against Yoon-seo in an office he picked right next to hers. He vows he will never let her go and turns up his charms. He attacks her by flirting and clings to her in the most pitiful way. Meanwhile, Yoon-seo succumbs to his request to eat with him 27 times.

Episodes.Title: The Last Date
Episodes.Description: Ju-won and Yoon-seo wake up both in despair after realising what they did and said to each other last night, intoxicated. They try to avoid one another at the company but end up face-to-face awkwardly. Meanwhile, Ju-won's mother reminds Yoon-seo of the promise she had made her, and Yoon-seo's brother gets into trouble at school for school bullying.

Episodes.Title: The Business Trip
Episodes.Description: An unknown number keeps texting Yoon-seo's phone with messages only an ex-boyfriend would text, making her suspect Ju-won. When she confronts him about it, she makes a fool of herself. Meanwhile, the company's new venture in the vacation sector opens a hanok getaway where Yoon-seo's team and Ju-won go for a business trip.

Episodes.Title: The Anonymous Texter
Episodes.Description: Ju-won leaves his family and shows up at Yoon-seo's door. His appearance exposes their relationship to the team, who even discover that their breakup was because of Ju-won's family's opposition, causing them to create an unbearable atmosphere for her in the office. Meanwhile, a crisis hits the Hanok Stay grand opening art exhibition, but Yoon-seo is away from her desk to handle it.

Episodes.Title: Can't Get Over Him
Episodes.Description: Yoon-seo struggles to clarify her relationship with Ju Won, even though she knows it's over. Ju-won's lingering feelings make it even harder for her. On top of that, Seong-min unexpectedly enters her life, sparking Ju-won’s jealousy. Feeling overwhelmed, she lashes out at Seong-min’s frivolous words and actions.

Episodes.Title: Another Tactic
Episodes.Description: While Yoon-seo and Seong-min seem to be getting closer, Ju-won becomes jealous and resorts to Si-won's advice of turning on his belligerent side. His sudden demeanor confuses Yoon-seo and frustrates her, angering her. But when she sees Ju-won with another woman, she is shocked by how flustered it made her.

Episodes.Title: The Marriage Proposal
Episodes.Description: Ju-won shows up at Yoon-seo's mother's funeral. He's there for her once again, and she cries in his solace. Then, he surprises her with a marriage proposal, leaving her speechless. As he waits anxiously for her answer, circumstances force him to go to Spain, but Yoon-seo rushes to see him at the airport as if she will lose him forever.

Episodes.Title: Seeking Happiness
Episodes.Description: Yoon-seo realises that before she can be honest about her relationship with Ju-won, there's something she needs to address first. Aware that the result might not be favourable, she decides to handle the situation on her own without involving Ju-won. Meanwhile, Si-won and Mi-jin are enjoying a wonderful night out together, but what starts as a moment of sincere honesty unexpectedly turns awkward.

Episodes.Title: A Cinderella Is Born
Episodes.Description: While Ju-won and Yoon-seo enjoy the outdoors, the shocking news of Sun-joo's husband's affair in New York spreads. To remedy the shattered image of the company, Sun-joo allows Yoon-seo to marry Ju-won. However, she will expose Yoon-seo's impoverished background to show the humility of the conglomerate family. Ju-won learns about this and then charges to confront his mother angrily, but Yoon-seo stops him.

Entries.Title: To The X Who Hated Me
Jazz For Two
Entries.Description: Tae Yi meets Se Heon in the music classroom, where he gives Se Heon a stern warning.

Episodes.Title: Summer Time
Episodes.Description: Tae Yi meets Se Heon in the music classroom, where he gives Se Heon a stern warning.

Episodes.Title: My Foolish Heart
Episodes.Description: After a confrontation, Tae Yi decides to take Se Heon seriously, but it also brings back memories of his past.

Episodes.Title: I Didn't Know About You
Episodes.Description: Joo Ha invites Se Heon to sing at a karaoke bar, and his actions towards Se Heon anger Tae Yi.

Episodes.Title: Alone Together
Episodes.Description: An accidental kiss leads to a confrontation between Joo Ha and Do Yoon. Tae Yi unexpectedly faints at school which raises Se Heon's concerns.

Episodes.Title: Gentle Rain
Episodes.Description: A performance brings Tae YI and Se Heon closer together while the distance between Se Heon and his father grows deeper.

Episodes.Title: The Touch Of Your Lips
Episodes.Description: Tae Yi takes in Se Heon, who has run away from home, and Tae Yi's gestures begin to emotionally affect Se Heon.

Episodes.Title: In A Sentimental Mood
Episodes.Description: The song that Tae Yi plays leads to a secret being revealed about Se Heon's brother.

Episodes.Title: Jazz For Two
Episodes.Description: Tae Yi encounters Se Heon's brother, and the encounter reveals the story of the song.

Entries.Title: Love For Love's Sake
Entries.Description: Tae Myung Ha accidentally enters Cha Yeo Woon's life, but he needs to keep his distance from him.

Episodes.Title: Happiness
Episodes.Description: Tae Myung Ha accidentally enters Cha Yeo Woon's life, but he needs to keep his distance from him.

Episodes.Title: Friends
Episodes.Description: Tae Myung Ha accepts Cha Yeo Woon's phone call, but the call makes him feel that something's off.

Episodes.Title: Affection
Episodes.Description: Tae Myung Ha sends Cha Yeo Woon a thoughtful gift, but Yeo Woon's reaction is not what he expected.

Episodes.Title: Progress
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeo Woon becomes more fond of Tae Myung Ha, and Yeo Woon proposes for the two of them to go on a date.

Episodes.Title: Relationship
Episodes.Description: Tae Myung Ha is given a new mission and at the same time, he discovers that Cha Yeo Woon has been hiding something from him.

Episodes.Title: Love
Episodes.Description: As Tae Myung Ha and Cha Yeo Woon get closer, more challenges come their way.

Episodes.Title: Choose
Episodes.Description: Time is running out as Tae Myung Ha desperately tries to complete his mission against worsening odds.

Episodes.Title: The answer
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeo Woon finds a pen on Tae Myung Ha's desk: what kind of ending will be written for the two of them?

Entries.Title: EN-DRAMA
Entries.Description: EN-DRAMA's first episode shows the seven boys reuniting on valentine's day. At a certain point, they start questioning each other about keeping secrets and end up agreeing to put their phones on the table in sight of everyone, a game that leads the episode.

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Time (완벽한 타인)
Episodes.Description: EN-DRAMA's first episode shows the seven boys reuniting on valentine's day. At a certain point, they start questioning each other about keeping secrets and end up agreeing to put their phones on the table in sight of everyone, a game that leads the episode.

Episodes.Title: The Girl We All Loved Before 'Yang Jungwon' (그 시절 우리 모두가 좋아했던 소녀 '양정원')
Episodes.Description: The story goes back in time to show Jungwon's story with Eunjin.

Episodes.Title: The Girl We All Loved Before 'Lee Heeseung' (그 시절 우리 모두가 좋아했던 소녀 '이희승')
Episodes.Description: Now it's time for Heeseung's relation with Eunjin.

Episodes.Title: The Girl We All Loved Before 'Park Jongsung' (그 시절 우리 모두가 좋아했던 소녀 '박종성')
Episodes.Description: Jay's story with Eunjin doesn't begin that well, will something change their relationship?

Episodes.Title: The Girl We All Loved Before 'Sim Jaeyun' (그 시절 우리 모두가 좋아했던 소녀 '심재윤')
Episodes.Description: Will Jaeyun be able to handle his feelings when the girl he used to like appears again?

Episodes.Title: The Girl We All Loved Before 'Park Sunghoon' (그 시절 우리 모두가 좋아했던 소녀 '박성훈')
Episodes.Description: Park Sunghoon's used to being alone, will he accept Eunjin's wish to be part of the caligraphy club and with that, let her get close to him?

Episodes.Title: The Girl We All Loved Before 'Kim Sunoo' (그 시절 우리 모두가 좋아했던 소녀 '김선우')
Episodes.Description: Sunoo's story with Eunjin starts at a convenience store, where they find out how similar they are to each other.

Episodes.Title: The Girl We All Loved Before 'Ni-Ki' (그 시절 우리 모두가 좋아했던 소녀 '니키')
Episodes.Description: Ni-Ki hopes to find his one-in-a-lifetime encounter, will Eunjin be the one he's been waiting for?

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Valentine (완벽한 밸런타인)
Episodes.Description: Going back to the future, the boys decide it's time to reveal who got to confess to Eunjin.

Entries.Title: Bitter Sweet Hell
Entries.Description: In the glittering facade of Young-won's world, envy festers around her flawless career and family life. But a chance encounter with a mysterious client during a counseling session leaves behind an unsettling residue of emotions. From that moment on, her reality unravels like a tapestry in a tempest, mirroring the heart-wrenching abandonment she experienced in her youth when her father chose to end his own life. Or so she believed.

Episodes.Title: The Pigeon House
Episodes.Description: In the glittering facade of Young-won's world, envy festers around her flawless career and family life. But a chance encounter with a mysterious client during a counseling session leaves behind an unsettling residue of emotions. From that moment on, her reality unravels like a tapestry in a tempest, mirroring the heart-wrenching abandonment she experienced in her youth when her father chose to end his own life. Or so she believed.

Episodes.Title: A Downright Lie
Episodes.Description: Young-won senses a web of deception woven by her supposedly trusted family. This realization ignites a spark of suspicion, compelling her to uncover the truth behind her father's death. Rumors swirl, hinting that her father-in-law's demise mirrors a tale from her mother-in-law's novel. As these whispers grow louder, cracks begin to fracture Young-won's once polished facade.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Lights
Episodes.Description: Young-won and Sa-kang shift Ji-eun to Honghak Hospital, which is just a stone's throw from their vacation home. Together, they brainstorm every conceivable scenario of what could've befallen Ji-eun and Jae-jin. While Young-won harbours suspicions about her mother-in-law due to the odd occurrences of late, she deems it crucial to join forces with her to locate Jae-jin first.

Episodes.Title: Mutual Assistance
Episodes.Description: Although Young-won is unhappy about Sa-kang concealing his affair from her, they prioritize gathering clues to find Jae-jin. Following these leads, they eventually arrive at Yokji Island. Shortly after getting there, they hear about a submerged car being found in the sea. Sa-kang immediately questions whether it's the vehicle her son rented.

Episodes.Title: A Trap
Episodes.Description: Young-won empathizes with Jae-jin, coming to terms with his passing. However, Sa-kang struggles to accept the reality of her son's demise, pushing for an ongoing search. Eventually, news of Jae-jin’s incident spread, fueling rumours linking the missing person to Young-won’s family. As a crowd of reporters converges outside her house, her remaining family grapples with another crisis.

Episodes.Title: Is Your Family Well?
Episodes.Description: Young-won and Sa-kang question what Se-na’s motives could have been for approaching Jae-jin. Sa-kang believes Se-na was targeting her, but Young-won thinks otherwise. Meanwhile, filled with more hatred toward Jae-jin than ever, Young-won shifts her focus to protecting her son. The pieces of the puzzle begin to fall into place, revealing the essence of Jae-jin’s disappearance, but Young-won’s anxiety only grows.

Episodes.Title: A Sweet Hell
Episodes.Description: Jae-jin's return home leads Young-won to question why Se-na chose to send him back. Young-won initiates a deeper investigation into Se-na's identity. Meanwhile, Sa-kang is pleased that her son has returned. Jae-jin then gathers the family in the dining room and unveils the family's secrets one by one.

Episodes.Title: The Swamp Of Motherly Love
Episodes.Description: Young-won is solely focused on her son, Sa-kang is always thinking about what's best for her son, and Ji-eun is determined not to lose Jae-jin. With all these obsessions under one roof, Young-won's family begins to fall further apart. Adding to the turmoil, So-yi visits Young-won, revealing she is pregnant with Do-hyun's baby. Young-won realises it's time to confront Se-na directly to protect what's left of her family before it’s too late.

Episodes.Title: Witch Hunt
Episodes.Description: After watching Young-won's threatening message, Se-na appears at the broadcast station. Filled with rage, she grabs Young-won by the neck in a manner suggesting an attempt to harm her. Fortunately, the police arrive just in time to rescue Young-won and arrest Se-na. Young-won subsequently searches for evidence to prove Se-na's crimes and ensure she remains in custody, but it proves to be a challenging task.

Episodes.Title: Gone Night
Episodes.Description: Sa-kang gets framed for killing An Yo-sub. Based on the evidence found at the scene, it is difficult for Sa-kang to avoid the charge. Jae-jin reveals to Young-won that he thinks Tae-oh approached him intentionally. Young-won finds out that Tae-oh is using a fake name and that he is actually Oh Tae-hwan, the older twin brother of Oh Ji-hwan.

Episodes.Title: Small Embers Everywhere
Episodes.Description: It turns out Se-na killed Yo-sub to frame Young-won for murder. However, Tae-oh meddled in to put the blame on Sa-kang. Young-won lures Tae-oh into her house, and he gets caught in the end. Tae-oh blames Young-won for destroying his family. Meanwhile, Se-na approaches Ji-eun and convinces her to expose Jae-jin’s family's secrets.

Episodes.Title: Almost Ordinary Family
Episodes.Description: While Young-won holds a press conference, Sa-kang visits Tae-oh in prison and makes him confess that it was Se-na who killed Yo-sub. Se-na kidnaps Do-hyun to lure Young-won to the vacation home. Jae-jin confesses that Ji-eun performed ghost surgery for him and gives up his license. Meanwhile, Sa-kang decides to leave the family.

Entries.Title: Summer Vacation of Visionary Vision
Entries.Description: Members of VV spent their summer vacation by travelling to a villa in Gapyeong. On their way to their staycation, VV enjoyed their bus ride thanks to snacks, karaoke sessions, and fun banter between members. Once they arrived at the villa, they relaxed and made themselves comfortable around the place.

Episodes.Title: Breaking News! tripleS Visionary Vision refused to leave VV HAUS
Episodes.Description: Members of VV spent their summer vacation by travelling to a villa in Gapyeong. On their way to their staycation, VV enjoyed their bus ride thanks to snacks, karaoke sessions, and fun banter between members. Once they arrived at the villa, they relaxed and made themselves comfortable around the place.

Episodes.Title: VV dove into the swimming pool and WAV fell in love with VV
Episodes.Description: After settling into their villa, VV decided to enjoy their vacation by having a pool party, while some started writing letters for their fellow members before joining in the fun. Afterwards, they would gather in the living room to play the Mafia game, where the winners and losers would receive an interesting reward and punishment, respectively.

Episodes.Title: The last day of VV's summer vacation was filled with heartfelt tears
Episodes.Description: VV had team dinner before gathering in the living room once more for the main event, the VV Mailbox, where members finally give the letters they wrote to their fellow members.

Entries.Title: Let Free the Curse of Taekwondo
Entries.Description: Despite Do-hoe's cold demeanor, the lively Ju-young shows his warmth and kindness.

Episodes.Title: Ice Cream
Episodes.Description: Despite Do-hoe's cold demeanor, the lively Ju-young shows his warmth and kindness.

Episodes.Title: What I Don't Know
Episodes.Description: Ju-young eases the tension between Do-hoe and his father, and the two boys' relationship takes a turn for the better.

Episodes.Title: Mirror
Episodes.Description: Ju-young clashes with Do-hoe's father, and the two youths are forced to separate.

Episodes.Title: The Curse of Taekwondo
Episodes.Description: A tragedy accidentally reunites Ju-young and Do-hoe, but Do-hoe is less than friendly to Ju-young.

Episodes.Title: Between the Setting Sun and Loneliness
Episodes.Description: Do-hoe is interested in disposing of his family's taekwondo gym, and he and Ju-young have a chance to get things off their chest.

Episodes.Title: Repeat
Episodes.Description: Ju-young and Do-hoe get into a verbal argument. Meanwhile, Do-hoe gets involved in a student's problem.

Episodes.Title: Looking for You
Episodes.Description: A secret is revealed when Do Hoe finds old report cards in a glove compartment.

Episodes.Title: Inside the Belly of the Shark
Episodes.Description: Do Hoe and Hyeon Ho finally open up; Do Hoe starts preparing for exams with Ju Yeong supporting him.

Entries.Title: Boys Be Brave!
Entries.Description: When the person he has a crush on suddenly moves into his house, Jin Woo tells his new roommate to move out by 10PM.

Episodes.Title: I Can't Confess
Episodes.Description: When the person he has a crush on suddenly moves into his house, Jin Woo tells his new roommate to move out by 10PM.

Episodes.Title: Finding Your Ideal Type
Episodes.Description: After learning what Jin Woo's ideal type is, Ki Sub decides to reach his goal by the deadline.

Episodes.Title: The Contract That Started It All
Episodes.Description: Jin Woo accepts the contract proposed by Ki Sub and begins living with him for a week, and is surprised by Ki Sub's success in meeting the criteria of his ideal type, which he thought was impossible. On the other hand, Balg Eum is shaken by the appearance of In Ho, whom he had feelings for in high school, and after thinking about it, he coldly pushes him away.

Episodes.Title: My Ideal Type And You Who Suddenly Appear Unexpectedly
Episodes.Description: Jin Woo unexpectedly kisses Ki Sub. Frustrated that his first kiss didn't go well, he goes to the library to study and read romance books, when he meets Hye Jin, a woman who looks like her ideal type. Balg Eum succumbs to In Ho's enthusiasm and promises to go on only three dates with him, but...

Episodes.Title: Someone Who I Can Love
Episodes.Description: During their date, Jin Woo, who couldn't stop thinking about Ki Sub, evades Ki Sub's question about his relationship with Hye Jin. Worried about Jin Woo, Ki Sub is confronted by Hye Jin, who tells him to disappear for Jin Woo's sake. Meanwhile, Balg Eum and In Ho spend time alone at home.

Episodes.Title: Knowing One's Heart, Singing Words Of Love
Episodes.Description: After leaving Jin Woo's house, Ki Sub feels unwell and goes to the elementary school where his sister works. When Ki Sub finally realizes his feelings and goes to Jin Woo's house, Jin Woo isn't there. Balg Eum, upset that the second date didn't go as planned, became emotional, and the feelings he had kept hidden burst out...

Episodes.Title: The Gift I've Always Wanted To Receive
Episodes.Description: The two finally reunite. Clearing up their misunderstandings, they spend a pleasant night together at Jin Woo's family home. Learning about Jin Woo's childhood, Ki Sub decides to plan a surprise for him. The next day, deeply moved by the heartfelt surprise, Jin Woo finally makes up his mind...

Episodes.Title: Promise Of Love At First 'Sight'
Episodes.Description: Ki Sub mustered the courage to honestly express his feelings to his family to clear up unresolved issues. In an attempt to cheer up the despondent Balg Eum, they both volunteer to help with a countdown party. In Ho, upon learning Balg Eum's true feelings, also visits the shop to give a final farewell...

Episodes.Title: A Ring That Has Woken Up From a Deep Sleep

Entries.Title: BEGINS ≠ YOUTH
Entries.Description: 6 boys who already have a strong bond, and Hwan, an outsider who just arrived in Songju. One misunderstanding leads to a conflict between Hwan and the other boys. In the end, Hwan realizes that his prejudice was the problem, not the boys.

Episodes.Title: Am I Wrong..?
Episodes.Description: 6 boys who already have a strong bond, and Hwan, an outsider who just arrived in Songju. One misunderstanding leads to a conflict between Hwan and the other boys. In the end, Hwan realizes that his prejudice was the problem, not the boys.

Episodes.Title: Mama
Episodes.Description: The boys begin to clear up their misunderstandings and understand each other's pain. They become closer than family as they prepare a birthday party for Cein, who has always been alone.

Episodes.Title: Lie
Episodes.Description: The boys rely on each other more than their families, more than anyone else. However, some secrets they bury in their own hearts become lies and secret wounds.

Episodes.Title: Anpanman
Episodes.Description: They barely manage to live their own lives, yet they become superheroes when they have to protect each other. But they don't have any flashy gadgets like Batman or powers like Superman.he boys begin to clear up their misunderstandings and understand each other's pain. They become closer than family as they prepare a birthday party for Cein, who has always been alone.

Episodes.Title: Mikrocosmos
Episodes.Description: They become each other's earth, the only place they can live and breathe. An insignificant microcosmos covered with scars, but they still keep dreaming in their own little world.

Episodes.Title: Cetomimidae
Episodes.Description: Just as fish of the same species evolve into different forms under the influence of their environment, the boys have grown into their own personalities over the past half year, for better or worse…

Episodes.Title: Man In The Mirror
Episodes.Description: They become each other's mirrors, which allows them to realize their own pain even more clearly. They have no idea that their own pain will hurt the others like broken shards of a mirror.

Episodes.Title: 13th Apostle
Episodes.Description: The boys confess their secrets to each other in the same way they would to a Catholic priest. Strange confessions from young boys who have no sins to atone for, just like how people sacrifice only the purest lambs.

Episodes.Title: Asteroid 2019 OK
Episodes.Description: Huge dangers that are so close yet go unnoticed. Like the asteroid in 2019 that flashed by us without anyone noticing.

Episodes.Title: Hide And Seek
Episodes.Description: The trauma that made the young boy suffer had forced him to hide. But the boy refuses to hide anymore and decides to find the truth.

Episodes.Title: The Note
Episodes.Description: The boys put all the events behind them and moved on with their lives. But a single note starts to connect them once more.

Episodes.Title: Begins ∞ Youth
Episodes.Description: The boys, while adapting to their own lives and beginning to find individual solutions, are confronted with unbearable tragedies that repeat like a treadmill. The boy who realizes the truth takes a step from the end toward a new beginning.

Entries.Title: I Love You Bit By Bit

Episodes.Title: Finding Handsome
Episodes.Description: A journey of a disbanded unknown idol member who dreams of a comeback to find his missing former member, Handsome.

Entries.Title: Gangster Like Me Got a Boyfriend
Brewing Love
Entries.Description: After wrapping up another case of an unpaid bill, Yong -ju gets dragged into another dilemma with the competition. Although it's resolved amicably, she hears her sales branch is on the verge of closing due to an extremely loved craft beer. Meanwhile, Min-ju continues to brew his Naro Beer, the beer everyone loves, in the Chungcheong Province while giving Chan-hui a job and blocking out the things that overwhelm him.

Episodes.Title: A Beer Worth Tasting
Episodes.Description: After wrapping up another case of an unpaid bill, Yong -ju gets dragged into another dilemma with the competition. Although it's resolved amicably, she hears her sales branch is on the verge of closing due to an extremely loved craft beer. Meanwhile, Min-ju continues to brew his Naro Beer, the beer everyone loves, in the Chungcheong Province while giving Chan-hui a job and blocking out the things that overwhelm him.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Down Walls
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju gets a chance to save the Busan branch and heads to work at the head office. All she needs to do is win over Yoon Min-ju to work with Jisang Liquor. After realizing he was the man she met at the carnival, she learns how difficult Min-ju could be. However, Yong-ju doesn't give up, and her strong mentality begins to break down his walls.

Episodes.Title: Uilhan Hop Beer Festival
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju's persistence works its way down Min-ju's nerves, but he still has room for her as the empath he is. However, he still pushes her away. While the town prepares for the Uilhan Hop Beer Festival, Yong-ju doesn't give up and heads to the Uilhan Pub to drink as much as she can, causing Min-ju to show up. Meanwhile, Ah-reum gathers the town for a meeting and reveals something shocking.

Episodes.Title: Brewing Tension
Episodes.Description: Convincing Yoon Min-ju to collaborate with Jisang Liquor is proving challenging for Yong-ju. However, she’s unwilling to exploit his vulnerabilities to secure his agreement. Facing open hostility from the villagers, she opts for a patient approach, hoping Min-ju will eventually recognise her genuine intentions. Meanwhile, a significant part of the beer festival preparations go wrong just before the event is set to begin.

Episodes.Title: Cheating Not Allowed
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju and her task force team members have a workshop in a coastal city. Watching Yong-ju jump into the ocean to save a person from drowning, Min-ju realizes that his feelings for Yong-ju are growing. Also, they learn that their competitor is playing a cheat to increase its sales. Meanwhile, Chan-hwi witnesses Ah-reum working part-time at a convenience store and discovers a big secret about Ah-reum.

Episodes.Title: Finding Spy
Episodes.Description: The higher-ups of Jisang Liquor suddenly decide to change the business strategy for the new product Yong-ju and Min-ju are working on together. Yong-ju strongly believes that there’s a spy in her task force behind the higher-ups' decision. When Min-ju is short of hands with the rising volume of orders from his clients, unexpected supporters arrive at his brewery to offer help.

Episodes.Title: Happy Families
Episodes.Description: After learning that Yong-ju is his saviour, Min-ju falls head over heels for her, but something tells him something isn't right. He terrorises the town for comfort, driving the townspeople mad. Meanwhile, the first beer sample produced between Uilhan Brewery and Jisang Liquor is poured and tasted. Later, Min-ju discovers that Yong-ju's grandmother's health conditions could have been his fault, pushing him to retreat into the mountains.

Episodes.Title: Hello and Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju struggles to understand her feelings toward Min-ju. Sensing this, Min-ju reassures her that he won’t rush her and will wait until she’s ready. However, when Min-ju’s high school friend and former girlfriend pays him a visit, it stirs jealousy in Yong-ju. Later, Min-ju invites Yong-ju on a date, but as she returns home afterwards, she notices an unusual and unsettling silence in the house.

Episodes.Title: Special Ordinary Days
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju's deeply crushed heart from her grandmother's passing pulls Min-ju even closer. As she grieves, Min-ju persuades her to join his village's first-ever sports festival, where the village people lend their support. Meanwhile, Yong-ju musters up her courage to profess her affection for Min-ju, and the YouTuber from the landslide returns with a sinister motive involving Jjuan, a beauty he can't believe is with Soon-kwan.

Episodes.Title: Internal and External Battles
Episodes.Description: Contrary to what Yong-ju and Min-ju had hoped, the internal evaluation of their latest beer lineup yielded disastrous results. Sensing internal opposition, they propose an irresistible offer to revive their new beer. Meanwhile, Chan-hwi battles his past traumas, which threaten to take away the love of his life.

Episodes.Title: Tangled In Love and Brew
Episodes.Description: Recognising the taste inconsistencies between batches of their newly launched beer lineup, Yong-ju and Min-ju find themselves debating fiercely over the best way to address this expensive problem. While their love for each other is strong enough to move mountains, their vastly different ways of expressing it leaves Yong-ju feeling deeply hurt. Just as they believe they've managed to contain the situation, it quickly spirals out of control.

Episodes.Title: Finding a New Path
Episodes.Description: Yong-ju cracks down on the malicious online sabotagers hired by Baekmok Liquor and works to revive Together's tarnished image. With a bit of help from the chairman of the National Liquor Wholesalers Association, Yong-ju and the team captured the hearts of their partners, selling all their beer. Meanwhile, Yong-ju deeply contemplates the next chapter of her life as she sits at her desk writing her resignation letter.

Entries.Title: Fragile
Entries.Description: Is it the low marks from the tutoring center bothering Ji Yu? Or is it the cold shoulders at school? Ji Yu feels so small and tries to find peace through her boyfriend. Ji Yu fails to find friends after the semester begins, but A Ra, the transferring student, approaches Ji Yu. Meanwhile, Ji Yu starts have doubts about Chan Seong - her entire world.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Is it the low marks from the tutoring center bothering Ji Yu? Or is it the cold shoulders at school? Ji Yu feels so small and tries to find peace through her boyfriend. Ji Yu fails to find friends after the semester begins, but A Ra, the transferring student, approaches Ji Yu. Meanwhile, Ji Yu starts have doubts about Chan Seong - her entire world.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Ji Yu is in agony, the person who understands her is San, who is always by her side. Meanwhile, due to an incident with Do Ha, an older student, Ji Yu experiences an unexpected event. Ji Yu feels better as Chan Seong is sweet to her but not completely. Then Do Ha comes to Ji Yu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ji Yu starts spending time with her new friends. During this time, Ji Yu's relationship with Chan Seong gradually suffers. At the same time, the two suppress their frustrations over unresolved issues. Meanwhile, Ji Yu meets up with Do Ha, who keeps advancing to her, and San finds out, even though it was supposed to be a secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After talking to San, Ji-yu wants to be honest with Chan-seong, but it doesn't go her way; the more she tries to explain, the more Chan-seong misunderstands; in the end, Ji-yu is fed up and the two turn their backs against each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ji-yu meets with Chan-seong to have a talk and clear up a misunderstanding; she experiences an unexpected conflict with Mi-na later on; Ji-yu, who becomes the subject of a rumor once again, tries to resolve the situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After clearing things up with Mi-na, Ji-yu and her friends pay a visit to the gynecologist. Meanwhile, to make things right, Ji-yu goes to find Do-ha to rectify things. Chan-sung goes to meet Ji-yu after hearing about the rumors, but an uninvited guest shows up and things turn ugly. As the situation worsens, Ji-yu hears surprising news from San.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ji-yu is confused about Mi-na and San getting along so well. Then, Ji-yu gets hate DMs from an anonymous Instagram account. Instead of running away, Ji-yu makes up her mind to face reality. Taking courage, Ji-yu meets up with Chan-sung who has been avoiding her to have they heart-to-heart talk they couldn't have and share a genuine conversation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ji-yu decides to make decisions only for herself and decides to break up with Chan-sung. Then Ji-yu apologizes to Su-jin, who she must have been hurting all along. Meanwhile, sports day is coming up at Jungang High. Looking for San, Ji-yu goes to the nurse's office and sees something shocking.

Entries.Title: Blossom Campus
Entries.Description: Min Jae, a new transfer student, meets Yoon Chan and is a little bothered by his presence.

Episodes.Title: Repetition of Coincidence is Destiny!
Episodes.Description: Min Jae, a new transfer student, meets Yoon Chan and is a little bothered by his presence.

Episodes.Title: Can We Become Friends?
Episodes.Description: Yoon Chan goes with Min Jae to guitar practice, and Min Jae is surprised by a sudden kiss.

Episodes.Title: I Keep Wanting to See You
Episodes.Description: Min Jae and his professor talk about relationship troubles; Woo Hyuk starts to concern himself with Min Jae and Yoon Chan's relationship.

Episodes.Title: Just Ordinary Friends
Episodes.Description: Min Jae goes with Woo Hyuk to film a music video, and later gets concerned after overhearing Yoon Chan.

Episodes.Title: I'm Sorry and Thank You
Episodes.Description: Min Jae feels unwell and Woo Hyuk and Yoon Chan pay a house visit to him.

Episodes.Title: So, What Are We?
Episodes.Description: Min Jae starts working at a cafe part time, and Yoon Chan comes to help him every so often.

Entries.Title: Romance in the House
Entries.Description: A sudden fire claims the landlord's life at Family Villa. As tenants question the cause, Geum Ae-yeon worries about her family and a possible rent hike.

Episodes.Title: A Bolt from the Blue
Episodes.Description: A sudden fire claims the landlord's life at Family Villa. As tenants question the cause, Geum Ae-yeon worries about her family and a possible rent hike.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Yongdong-dong’s Rebel
Episodes.Description: Byeon Moo-jin settles at Family Villa, triggering Byeon Mi-rae's old grudges. To escape the tension with her once-estranged dad, she begins a house hunt.

Episodes.Title: The Great Byeon-sby's Secret
Episodes.Description: Moo-jin promises free rent and ends the house hunt for Mi-rae, who's upset he's flaunting his wealth. He clarifies: He's doing it to win Ae-yeon back.

Episodes.Title: The War of the Byeons
Episodes.Description: Moo-jin clears himself of suspicion in the fire accident. Later, Ae-yeon briefly disappears, leading to a chaotic family reunion at the police station.

Episodes.Title: A Midlife Crisis Begins
Episodes.Description: Ae-yeon turns Moo-jin at dinner but can't shake her lingering emotions. Curious, she starts looking into his mysterious 11-year absence.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Get Closer to You
Episodes.Description: Byeon Hyeon-jae moves into his dad's place, as per Mi-rae's wishes. Ae-yeon's tension eases when she learns about Moo-jin's time in Thailand.

Episodes.Title: Our Home Ground
Episodes.Description: Mi-rae leaves a note and goes missing — has she left Family Villa for good? Meanwhile, Moo-jin's unfortunate past begins to catch up with him.

Episodes.Title: The Promised Eighth Inning
Episodes.Description: Ae-yeon is furious after discovering Moo-jin and Mi-rae's bet involving her. But after calming down, she realizes they need to talk about their daughter.

Episodes.Title: Back to the Mi-rae
Episodes.Description: Ae-yeon urges her daughter to lead her own life and even finds her a new place to stay, leaving Mi-rae both angry and confused.

Episodes.Title: Tears are Saltier than Water
Episodes.Description: Things are looking up for the Byeons as Ae-yeon finds a career opportunity. Mi-rae mentors a new recruit at work and Moo-jin faces his past with grace.

Episodes.Title: Following the Journey of Moo-jin...
Episodes.Description: Moo-jin finally shares the story behind his newfound wealth, to the relief of Family Villa residents. But can this confession mend old wounds?

Episodes.Title: Our Romance
Episodes.Description: Moo-jin and Ae-yeon's reunion is on everyone's mind. As Ae-yeon reflects on their relationship, the family contemplates the true meaning of togetherness.

Entries.Title: Dear Hyeri
Entries.Description: Eun-ho and Hyun-oh, once a couple, now clash at the news station over an evening show that Eun-ho refuses to accept. Hyun-oh proposes to take the job to alleviate the situation, but they end up working together. While she realises how much she despises him for not being able to have him, Ji-on makes his move on her, and the Hye-ri inside her wakes up.

Episodes.Title: It's Never a Love Story
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho and Hyun-oh, once a couple, now clash at the news station over an evening show that Eun-ho refuses to accept. Hyun-oh proposes to take the job to alleviate the situation, but they end up working together. While she realises how much she despises him for not being able to have him, Ji-on makes his move on her, and the Hye-ri inside her wakes up.

Episodes.Title: The Connection Between You and Me
Episodes.Description: Hyun-oh meets Eun-ho, but she doesn’t recognise him, saying she’s not Eun-ho. Hye-ri and Joo-yeon become closer and Joo-yeon takes her into his house. Meanwhile, Eun-ho joins Mi-yeon and her crew to cover a serious social issue. While secretly filming footage alone, Eun-ho gets in danger and struggles to survive.

Episodes.Title: Wind
Episodes.Description: Hyun-oh saves Eun-ho but doesn't get the thanks he should and only gets another stern warning to stay away from her. Jeon Jae-yong returns to the station and stirs things up after seeing Eun-ho working in Media N Seoul Parkade. Meanwhile, Hye-ri and Joo-yeon get closer, but Eun-ho wakes up to find Joo-yeon's employee card and goes to meet him.

Episodes.Title: Love is a Star
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho smashes a mirror and faints. She doesn’t remember anything about it. She tells the doctor that she has found happiness and doesn’t want to abandon Hye-ri. Meanwhile, when Eun-ho and Hyun-oh deliver the news, a clip regarding two sisters reminds Eun-ho of her past and she panics in the newsroom.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho wakes up to see Hyun-oh with her. She can't remember what happened after the elevator and figure out why he is with her. After seeing her doctor at Hyun-oh's request, she realises the Hye-ri inside her struggles to break free to hold onto the happiness Eun-ho doesn't have. Hyun-oh stays by her side as if they never broke up. Meanwhile, Joo-yeon can't get Hye-ri off his mind and rushes to see her only to be with Hyun-oh.

Episodes.Title: The History of Farewells
Episodes.Description: Hyun-oh’s gambler father died in a fire accident when Hyun-oh was a minor. When Hyun-oh was about to be sent to an orphanage, the boss of Red Rainbow offered him a place to stay under one condition. Because of his complicated background, Hyun-oh always hesitates about marriage. Meanwhile, Hyun-oh’s place of 9pm news gets replaced. It turns out that Hyun-oh exchanged his 9pm news position for Eun-ho’s noon news position.

Episodes.Title: Pretending To Be Hye Ri
Episodes.Description: Eun Ho decides to live as Hye Ri one more time. Pretending to be Hye Ri, she participates in a dodgeball game with Joo Yeon on a sports day of Media N Seoul. However, Joo Yeon soon finds out that Eun Ho and Hye Ri are the same person. Meanwhile, Eun Ho and Shin Joong try to come up with an idea of how to help Hyun Oh get the opportunity to become the 9pm news anchor.

Entries.Title: Mina, You Changed Your Profile Picture Again
Crash
Entries.Description: Insurance Investigator Cha Yeon-ho (Lee Min-ki) is accidentally caught up by the Traffic Crime Investigation Team (TCI) during a "Car Fraud" gang bust.  During questioning he shares his case records of a possible Vehicular Serial Murder case with Lieutenant Min So-hee (Kwak Sun-young).  So-hee gets personally involved after she finds out an acquaintance may have been a victim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Insurance Investigator Cha Yeon-ho (Lee Min-ki) is accidentally caught up by the Traffic Crime Investigation Team (TCI) during a "Car Fraud" gang bust.  During questioning he shares his case records of a possible Vehicular Serial Murder case with Lieutenant Min So-hee (Kwak Sun-young).  So-hee gets personally involved after she finds out an acquaintance may have been a victim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Killer Jung Ho-kyu (Bae Yoo-ram) plots his revenge against Jo Seok-tae (Lee Do-goon) for aiding Lt. Min So-hee.  Investigator Cha Yeon-ho obtains damaging evidence against Ho-kyu. Yeon-ho gets labeled as a whistle blower and quits his job. Capt. Jeong Chae-man (Heo Sung-tae) of TCI hires him into the team as a Lieutenant due to his investigative expertise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: TCI’s investigation into ghostly apparitions causing vehicular accidents uncovers a multiparty Car Scam Ring affiliation.  So-hee’s father, Min Yong-gun (Yoo Seung-mok), shares some of her background story with Yeon-ho.  Yeon-ho and So-hee go undercover as husband and wife.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The TCI investigates the case of a woman jumping from a car.  The Joint Investigative Unit moves to Namgang Police Station and takes over TCI’s case. Cha Yeon-ho is disgraced when a culprit gets away. So-hee decides to give him personal training in the finer arts of police arrest techniques.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The Hit and Run Case sheds light on a Car Thief and Serial Rapist case.  Mysterious envelopes related to Cha Yeon-ho’s tragic past traffic accident appears.  Min So-hee may be a little over zealous in the police arrest techniques training. Yeon-ho confronts Deputy Commissioner Pyo Myung-hak (Heo Jung-do) who investigated his case in the past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeon-ho is interrogated in regards to his past vehicular homicide case.  When Director General Lee Tae-joo (Oh Eui-sik) of the Joint Task Unit withholds information from his team and the TCI, they go to the aid of TCI.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Pyo Myung-hak is promoted to Commissioner General.  TCI’s investigation into a car carrier trailer rollover case finds that it was malicious and caused the death of a man driving home. Yang Jae-young (Heo Ji-won), the son of a former gangster, is murdered. Eo Hyeon-gyeong (Choi Moon-hee) meets Woo Dong-gi’s (Lee Ho-cheol’s) father, Woo Gil-soon (Joo Hyun).

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: TCI reveals a serial pattern in the Car Carrier Trailers Rollover Case which affected prior truck drivers for CY Logistics.  Woo Gil-soon was one of them.  Truck driver Han Kyung-soo (Han Sang-jo) confides the names of the individuals related to Cha’s past accident and that all had received threatening mail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: TCI is assigned the Yang Jae-young Murder Case.  Min Yong-gun (Yoo Seung-mok), So-hee’s father, gets involved in an accident while chasing a Hit and Run driver.  Evidence leads to Pyo Jung-wook (Kang Ki-doong), the Commissioner General’s son. Yeon-ho shares his knowledge of his accident from 10 years prior with So-hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeon-ho finds out that Kim Hyun-min (Kim Dae-ho), the National Forensic Service analyst is the culprit behind the threatening envelopes. Pyo Jung-wook seeks the help of former gangster Yang Seok-chang (Lee Yoo-joon), Chairman of YSC Group. Han Kyung-soo confesses who the actual culprits were in Yeon-ho's vehicular homicide case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: TCI succeeds in capturing the real culprits of the 10 year vehicular homicide,  car carrier and the Hit and Run cases.  During Pyo Jung-wook’s trial, Commissioner Pyo is also implicated and arrested. Conniving Lee Tae-joo is promoted to Chief Superintendent. Rather than being promoted the team is dissolved and transferred. Cha Yeon-ho is sent to remote Hwapyeong island.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: When a local Inn Keeper’s daughter disappears Cha Yeon-ho reaches out for help.  The old TCI gang takes vacation to assist him. The team is finally promoted with exception of Chief Jeong who had rendered his resignation.  When Chief Justice Shin So-jung (Park Ji-young) is promoted to Director National Office of Investigation, she seeks out Chief Jeong to reestablish the TCI.

Entries.Title: Level 9 Chairman
Entries.Description: Na I-soo, a naughty student who becomes chairman of the board at the elite school inherited from his father. Among the elite students, I-soo and they learn to know and change themselves.

Episodes.Title: The Other One and the Last One
Episodes.Description: Sajo Hyeon, the crown prince with two personalities in one body, meets a woman in a clothing shop. That woman is the only survivor of the Yeon clan, which was wiped out 10 years ago. In order to take revenge, Yeon Wol infiltrated the palace and eventually aimed the tip of her knife at the king

Episodes.Title: Yeon Wol, the Concubine
Episodes.Description: Ak-hee's clever maneuver results in Yeon Wol losing all her memories, placing her on the brink of becoming the Crown Prince's concubine. However, her innate instincts drive her to break free and discover her true identity and rightful place. While wandering beyond the palace confines, she crosses paths with Sajo Hyeon and, with hesitation, chooses to return to the palace, unknowingly stepping into a web of schemes set to engulf her.

Episodes.Title: Brushing Against Fate's Edge
Episodes.Description: With Sajo Hyeon's quick thinking, Yeon Wol manages to narrowly escape the life-threatening scheme. Overwhelmed with gratitude, Yeon Wol tries to express her thanks, unknowingly reopening deep scars for Sajo Hyeon. Sensing vulnerability, Ak-hee seizes the moment to assert control over Sajo Hyeon's body, eventually aiming to lock him up permanently.

Episodes.Title: Echoes of the Past
Episodes.Description: Yeon Wol, having regained her memories, prepares for the long-awaited revenge she has devoted her life to. Meanwhile, a clever move by Chung Ta allows Sajo Hyeon to avoid the binding ritual. Gradually, Sajo Hyeon finds comfort in Yeon Wol and starts to open up to her. A rumor swiftly spreads throughout the palace about Yeon Wol's true identity.

Episodes.Title: Sajo Seung's Mysterious Death
Episodes.Description: Following the enigmatic demise of Sajo Seung, Yeon Wol, wrongly labeled as the assailant, harbors suspicions that Sajo Yoong is the true mastermind behind Sajo Seung's death. Meanwhile, Sajo Hyeon finds himself unable to shake off the thoughts of Yeon Wol, who implored him to believe in her innocence. In the end, Hyeon opts to enter into a precarious arrangement with Ak Hee in a bid to rescue Yeon Wol.

Episodes.Title: Shuffled Kiss
Episodes.Description: Sajo Hyeon wakes up in the middle of a kiss between Ak-hee and Yeon Wol and has no idea what situation he is in. With the passage of time, the intimacy between Hyeon and Wol intensifies. At the same time, Hyeon becomes aware that Yung is involved in questionable activities, yet he feels powerless to take any action against him. Nevertheless, he discovers a motivation to oppose Yung.

Episodes.Title: Majesty Sajo Hyeon
Episodes.Description: As the newly crowned king, Sajo Hyeon becomes aware that there are more watchful eyes and attentive ears than he had initially expected, closely monitoring his every move. Meanwhile, Sajo Yung is busy concocting another scheme. Simultaneously, Yeon Wol, covertly supporting Hyeon as a court maid, catches wind of the news that Hyeon is slated to spend the night with the Queen.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Wol’s Unwavering Love
Episodes.Description: Ak-hee realizes who holds Yeon Wol's unwavering love, and a wave of jealousy washes over him. Yeon Wol notices suspicious activities within the palace and embarks on an investigation. Meanwhile, Yung, who harbors suspicions about Sajo Hyeon's true identity, approaches Chung-ta for a favor.

Episodes.Title: A Farewell
Episodes.Description: Yeon Wol chooses to leave the palace, encouraged by Ak-hee's commitment to assist Sajo Hyeon. Meanwhile, Sajo Hyeon, facing the ongoing disappearance of women, finds himself compelled to make a pivotal decision as the King. Yeon Wol, driven by the urgency of the situation, sets out on her own to rescue the missing women.

Episodes.Title: The Possessed King
Episodes.Description: Word begins to spread about a troubling rumor suggesting that an evil spirit has taken possession of the King. Sajo Hyeon quickly identifies the source of the rumor. Upon his return, he faces the challenge of restoring the rightful order within the royal family. Simultaneously, Ak-hee unwittingly becomes ensnared in Sajo Yung's trap, compelling him to extricate himself from Sajo Hyeon's body.

Episodes.Title: The Contagion
Episodes.Description: As the contagion continues to spread, more people are shifting their allegiance toward Sajo Yung, who is presently incarcerated. Meanwhile, Sajo Hyeon, incapacitated by a Suma dart, remains immobile and speechless, while Ak-hee endeavors to maintain stability within the nation. Yeon Wol diligently seeks any clues that might guide her to Chung-ta in a desperate attempt to rescue Sajo Hyeon.

Episodes.Title: Down Goes Ak-hee
Episodes.Description: Ak-hee, betrayed by Chung-ta, finds himself immobilized with a dagger lodged in his back. Though Sajo Hyeon regains consciousness, he is also incapacitated and unable to assist Ak-hee. With both Ak-hee and Hyeon bound, the situation worsens as Sajo Yung is released from prison. Meanwhile, Yeon Wol is risking everything to rescue Hyeon and finally receives a glimmer of hope from Chung-ta.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Palace Walls
Episodes.Description: Following the loss of his memories, Sajo Hyeon initiates a new chapter beyond the confines of the palace. Although reunited with Yeon Wol, his recollection of her identity may be absent, yet their profound connection persists, transcending the obstacles of his amnesia. Meanwhile, Yeon Wol embarks on a journey to honor the commitment she made for the antidote. Upon learning of her endeavor, Sajo Hyeon sets out in search of her.

Episodes.Title: Enthralling Offer
Episodes.Description: Ak-hee realizes that his presence is slowly fading away, and knowing all this, Chung-ta makes a tempting offer. Meanwhile, Sajo Hyeon and Yeon Wol are in shock and confusion when they find out that Geum-hwa has conceived a child. Seeing that Yeon Wol is not in her right mind, Yang Jae-yi takes a rather extreme measure to address the situation.

Episodes.Title: Unlocking Minds
Episodes.Description: Having gained access to Ak-hee's memories, Sajo Hyeon discerns the deception that has ensnared him and promptly rushes back to the palace. With Yang Jae-yi's demise, Yeon Wol emerges as the anticipated successor to lead the Daggers of the Wind. Meanwhile, Ak-hee is determined to acquire the dagger to execute his plot to eliminate Sajo Hyeon.

Episodes.Title: The Confrontation
Episodes.Description: After a fierce confrontation between Ak-hee and Sajo Hyeon, Ak-hee successfully plunges the dagger into Hyeon. Simultaneously, Sajo Yung readies himself for the throne. Meanwhile, Sajo Yung employs a cunning tactic, injecting a poisoned needle into Yeon Wol, who collapses immediately afterwards. Ak-hee becomes consumed by what he perceives as love for Yeon Wol.

Entries.Title: Good Partner
Entries.Description: It’s Yu Ri’s first day at Law Firm Daejeong, 1 of Korea’s top 3 law firms. She thought she’d be joining the corporate department, but instead, she was assigned to the divorce department. Eun Kyung, the nation’s divorce attorney, instantly knows that Yu Ri isn’t the right material for a divorce attorney. However, Yu Ri tries to win the case in her own way.

Episodes.Title: Divorce Attorney
Episodes.Description: It’s Yu Ri’s first day at Law Firm Daejeong, 1 of Korea’s top 3 law firms. She thought she’d be joining the corporate department, but instead, she was assigned to the divorce department. Eun Kyung, the nation’s divorce attorney, instantly knows that Yu Ri isn’t the right material for a divorce attorney. However, Yu Ri tries to win the case in her own way.

Episodes.Title: Two Women
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri’s straightforward nature struggles to comprehend some of the methods Eun Kyung employs. She is particularly shocked when she sees Eun Kyung persuading her clients to prioritize economic benefits over child custody. To Eun Kyung, who possesses far more experience than a novice, Yu Ri is just a rookie in the big leagues. What astonishes Yu Ri even more is Eun Kyung's reaction after she reveals a little secret she’s discovered.

Episodes.Title: From Family To Non-family
Episodes.Description: Yu Ri is surprised to hear that Eun Kyung doesn’t want to divorce Ji Sang even after finding out about his affair with Sa Ra. Yu Ri finally starts a session with a client on her own and gets her first case. However, the client decides to drop the lawsuit. Yu Ri decides to quit working for the divorce team.

Episodes.Title: A Show
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung asks Yu Ri to represent her for her divorce case against Ji Sang. Eun Kyung sends a letter of complaint to Sa Ra, letting everyone in the office know that she was involved in an unsavoury incident. Rumours about Eun Kyung and Ji Sang’s divorce circulate, but Eun Kyung doesn’t even bat an eye.

Episodes.Title: Office Husband
Episodes.Description: Ji Sang secretly leaks to a reporter that Eun Kyung might have an office husband and that she had an affair before him. Yu Ri decides to hear whether Eun Kyung and Woo Jin had an affair or not. Yu Ri convinces Eun Kyung to settle, but Eun Kyung doesn’t give in. Meanwhile, Yu Ri comes up with a brilliant idea to change the public’s opinion of Eun Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Qualifications To Be A Parent
Episodes.Description: The first hearing of Eun Kyung and Ji Sang’s divorce trial begins, and neither side wants to give up the custody of Jae Hui, their daughter. Jae Hui misunderstands Eun Kyung’s intention and thinks she wants to let her live with her father. Meanwhile, Yu Ri takes on a case of a couple who want to give up their custody.

Episodes.Title: In The Name Of Mother
Episodes.Description: As soon as Sa Ra gets promoted to chief manager, she gets dismissed from the law firm. Ji Sang tells Sa Ra that he has no intention of marrying her even if he gets divorced, which leaves her devastated. Meanwhile, Yu Ri’s stepmom comes to see Eun Kyung and threatens her to fire Yu Ri.

Episodes.Title: That's How Fatherhood Begins
Episodes.Description: Sa Ra is pregnant with Ji Sang’s child. However, Ji Sang’s lawyer advises him to abandon Sa Ra to win custody of his daughter. Sa Ra secretly puts the ultrasound picture of her baby in Jae Hui’s room, and Jae Hui eventually sees it. Meanwhile, Jae Hui finally meets the family investigator.

Episodes.Title: A Half Apology
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung finds out that Jae Hui knew about her dad’s affair with Sa Ra even before she did. Ji Sang breaks up with her after hearing what Sa Ra did to Jae Hui. Eun Kyung becomes emotional after finding out about Sa Ra’s pregnancy and what she did to Jae Hui. Hence, Yu Ri looks for a way to calm her down.

Episodes.Title: A Messed Up Story Or The Final Chapter
Episodes.Description: Jae Hui confides in Yu Ri that she wishes her parents’ divorce trial to end soon so that everyone can move on. She also chooses to live with Eun Kyung instead of her father and lets him know how much his lies hurt her. Meanwhile, Sa Ra miscarries her baby, and her relationship with Ji Sang ends.

Episodes.Title: Absence
Episodes.Description: Mr. Oh suggests Eun Kyung to go on a vacation and resign once she returns. Eun Kyung decides to go on a trip with Jae Hui, but things don’t go too smoothly. The Divorce Team gets twice as busy with Eun Kyung gone. Meanwhile, Yu Ri takes on a case and solves it on her own for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Decision Closing Argument
Episodes.Description: Daejeong signs an MOU with Chun Medical Foundation and takes a divorce case from its chairman, Chun Hwan Seo. Mr. Oh assigns the case to Yu Ri instead of Eun Kyung, and Yu Ri learns from him that he intends to fire Eun Kyung soon. Meanwhile, Eun Kyung finds out that Woo Jin will become the managing partner of Daejeong.

Episodes.Title: Resolution
Episodes.Description: Chun Hwan Seo calls Eun Kyung to his house, and she finds his wife unconscious on the floor. Yu Ri, who was waiting outside the house, calls the police when she doesn’t hear from Eun Kyung. Meanwhile, Woo Jin comes up with a plan to deal with the mess Chun Medical Foundation put Daejeong into.

Episodes.Title: The Skill of Fighting
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung decides to leave Daejeong and open up her own law firm. Although she starts out with a big ambition, it doesn’t turn out as well as she expected it to be. Yu Ri is given a choice to switch teams, but she hesitates. A new client visits Eun Kyung, but she sends her to Yu Ri, and Yu Ri does the same for Eun Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Honesty Or Truth
Episodes.Description: Eun Kyung realises that Yu Ri is the opposing counsel of her new client. They meet up to discuss a settlement, but they fail to find the middle ground. Eun Ho decides to leave Daejeong after much consideration and joins Eun Kyung’s new firm. After Eun Ho leaves the firm, Yu Ri realises how much he means to her.

Episodes.Title: Making A Choice The Right One
Episodes.Description: A year passes and Oh Dae Gyu's wife, Park Ae Yeon, files for divorce at Law Firm Daejeong, and Woo Jin assigns Yu Ri to take the case. Flabbergasted at facing his own company against him, Dae Gyu asks Eun Kyung to represent him. As Yu Ri and Eun Kyung try to settle outside the courtroom, Dae Gyu has a sudden change of heart. Meanwhile, Eun Kyung thinks of letting Jae Hui spend time with Ji Sang.
